headline: NHS rapid test cuts brain tumour diagnosis from weeks to hours
meta_description: A new NHS test dramatically speeds up brain tumour diagnosis, reducing wait times from weeks to just hours for patients.
summary_short: The NHS has introduced a rapid diagnostic test that can identify brain tumours in hours rather than weeks, transforming patient care.
body:
The NHS has introduced a rapid new test that cuts brain tumour diagnosis from weeks down to hours, offering patients faster answers and earlier access to treatment.

This breakthrough represents a significant shift in how the health service approaches neurological diagnosis. Where patients previously faced lengthy waits for results, the accelerated testing protocol now delivers critical information within a single day, allowing medical teams to begin treatment planning without delay.

The speed of diagnosis carries profound weight for patients and families facing uncertainty about a potential brain tumour. Reducing the diagnostic window from weeks to hours means fewer days spent in limbo, faster initiation of care pathways, and the potential for better outcomes when treatment can begin sooner.
quick_facts: New NHS test reduces diagnosis time from weeks to hours
Rapid testing enables faster access to brain tumour treatment
Breakthrough cuts patient waiting period dramatically
